verdict.rationale: RustDesk's own docs say Server Pro ships a management API alongside the web console, so a first-party API exists. Nothing shows it covers what the UI can do: client-side session actions such as remote control, file transfer and chat have no documented API, and the API appears limited to the paid Pro tier. Missing for 10: documented API scope or reference, evidence of UI-to-API parity, API coverage for client/session features, availability in the OSS edition, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Server Pro adds a web console, device groups, a shared address book, per-user and device-group access control, audit logs, and a management API.
